user.title: Set up Reiseanzeige
user.description: Credentials for the Timetables API from the DB API Marketplace (developers.deutschebahn.com, free plan). Every installation needs its own credentials. Optional: also subscribe the same application to “StaDa – Station Data” (Free4All) so the map can draw the route.

error.invalid_auth: The Timetables API does not accept these credentials. Is the application subscribed to “Timetables”?
error.cannot_connect: The Timetables API is not reachable right now.

data.grace_minutes: Keep showing a trip after arrival (minutes)
data.refresh_seconds: Shortest refresh interval during a trip (seconds)
